attribution.name: Codex
attribution.role: Implementation author preparing an unexecuted onboarding example; not an independent scientific reviewer

evidence.scope: Canonical H08 C/E evidence, comparative benefit untested and earlier prompt provenance unavailable
Superseded PR607 assertions are historical claims, not established methodology benefit
Merged PR608 established disposition conflicts with the canonical register
Unmerged proposed correction, not main or independent validation

uncertainty: H08 comparative benefit remains untested. This is a proposed controlled evaluation, not a productivity finding or proof from artifact identity. Reviewer independence, prompt provenance and resource budget need human review.
research_question: Does AI-assisted adversarial review reduce independently scored claim errors or improve reproduction yield relative to human-only and alternative-assisted work on matched repository research tasks?
falsification_criterion: Reject the preregistered benefit if a held-out matched comparison fails to exceed the declared minimum effect with the planned uncertainty interval, or if any apparent effect requires unverified claims, unequal budgets or evaluator leakage.
matched_control: Randomized matched task blocks: human-only, single-assistant, and adversarial-assistant workflows; identical source snapshots, task information, time/resource budgets and scoring rules. Blind adjudicators independent of generators establish source-grounded labels; record their relationships and uncertainty.
method: Before execution, preregister task sampling, effect threshold, sample-size rationale, randomization seed, exclusion/stopping rules and evaluator independence. Pilot only for feasibility; freeze a separate held-out confirmatory corpus. Retain prompts and artifacts with actual attribution; do not infer prompt history from commit authorship.
measurement_plan: Measure claim-error rates, reproduction yield, correction cost and provenance completeness. Report all task-level observations, between-task variation, paired effect estimates and uncertainty intervals; retain negative, blocked and inconclusive outcomes. Define an independent source/test oracle, blind scoring rubric and contamination checks before collecting outcomes.
expected_artifacts: Preregistered protocol, blinded task allocation and scoring rubric
Actual prompt/source/commit provenance and attribution with unavailable data marked
Independent adjudication and raw per-task outcomes including failures
Resource ledger, uncertainty analysis, hashes and reproduction report
resource_requirements: Explicit human-reviewed experiment and reviewer/time budget before execution
Local scratch workspace for a future approved study; no experiment resources used by this proposal
External model APIs or human recruitment require separate explicit authorization
security_requirements: Discovery interface remains offline and read-only; no experiment execution operation
Do not send repository data, prompts or credentials to external services without approval
No changes to accepted records, governance, ISA, VM, Axion or CanonFS
